text:
Maya: Quick UX nit — the 'Encrypted' pill in the Instance details is ambiguous. Users keep asking if it means 'BYOK enabled' vs 'data encrypted at rest' :thinking_face:
Sam: Do you mean the pill label or the tooltip?
Maya: Both. Current pill says 'Encrypted (KMS)' which looks like a key is attached but doesn't show alias vs id. On small screens the tooltip is hard to reach with keyboard.
Devon: +1 on keyboard focus. Also, the KMS key id is noisy. We should surface alias and a short affordance that expands to full key id.
Aisha: Security perspective: alias alone can be spoofed in the UI if we don't show the authority (e.g., AWS vs GCP). Recommend: "Encrypted — AWS KMS: alias/my-service-key" and an info button that reveals key id and last rotation.
Sam: Mock idea: pill shows two lines on hover/states: line1 = Encrypted · AWS KMS, line2 (smaller) = alias/my-service-key. Inline focus should trigger the same view as hover.
Oliver: For audit logs, we should keep events terse and consistent. Right now we have "encryption key updated" vs "KMS key rotated" elsewhere. Can we standardize on verbs: created/updated/rotated/deleted? Also timezone display should be ISO + human friendly tz.
Maya: Good call. Also noticed retention preset labels are 'Short/Default/Long' — testers confused what durations those map to. Could we show durations on hover or add a small secondary label: 'Short (7d)', etc? Accessibility: those should be programmatically exposed for screen readers.
Devon: Technically easy to add parentheses durations. For screen reader text we can add `aria-describedby` to the preset buttons.
Aisha: Also need to ensure retention changes are logged with previous_value->new_value in audit; currently only shows new value. That makes investigations hard.
Sam: UX follow-ups: 1) Rename pill to 'Encryption (AWS KMS)' and show alias. 2) Add keyboard-expand affordance to reveal full key id/rotation timestamp. 3) Retention presets: show durations inline and add sr-only descriptions. 4) Audit copy: standardize verbs and include previous_value for config changes.
Maya: I'll update the mock and push to Figma. @Devon can you confirm the small popup won't cause layout shift in compact panels? :eyes:
Devon: I'll prototype a non-blocking panel (position: absolute, will use transform for animation) and avoid reflow. Should be fine.
Oliver: I'll draft the audit copy guidelines in the docs repo after we land verb list. Suggest: "[Actor] [verb] [resource] — from [old] to [new] (ts timezone)"
ux-bot: Reminder — design review sync Fri 10am. Added this thread to the agenda.
Maya: Thanks everyone — will file follow-up tickets for accessibility and audit changes.
